prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, blunt bob rose pink hair — wearing a minimal two-piece of a tiny bra top of two small cups on thin strings and a micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, both made of frosted pale-sky-blue organza, the material evenly tinted and softly diffusing so her own skin tone glows through it as a gentle blur, the rest of her body bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin across her whole body, including where the sheer material veils it, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The tiny garments show real material behaviour: crisp organza holding fine translucent creases and a faint pearly sheen over the small cups and the tiny triangle, the thin strings pressing lightly into her skin. Pose: walking confidently toward the camera, shoulders back, chin lifted — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of silver leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in sky blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: defined brown-mauve eyeshadow, a precise winged liner, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, softly contoured cheeks, glossy rose-nude lips.

Background: a bright modern bus terminal with a clean pale concrete floor, a glass canopy, standard-height bus doors and a bench, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
